mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, code, source_id, source_code, source_type, status, invalid_status, invalid_remark, invalid_time, type, channel_id, channel_name, requisition_warehouse_id, requisition_warehouse_name, to_warehouse_id, to_warehouse_name, from_warehouse_id, from_warehouse_name, handle_user_id, handle_user_name, handle_time
mapper.select: select fmd.code, fmdd.fba_shipment_code as fbaShipmentCode, case when fmd.approve_status = 'approve'then '已发货' else '未发货' end as status, sum(fmdd.delivery_qty) as qty from first_mile_delivery fmd inner join first_mile_delivery_detail fmdd on fmd.id = fmdd.main_id and fmdd.is_deleted = false where fmd.is_deleted = false and fmd.source_id = #{id} group by fmd.code,fmd.create_time,fmdd.fba_shipment_code,fmd.approve_status order by fmd.create_time desc

select fmd.code, owi.code as fbaShipmentCode, case when fmd.approve_status = 'approve'then '已发货' else '未发货' end as status, sum(fmdd.delivery_qty) as qty from first_mile_delivery fmd inner join overseas_warehouse_inbound owi on fmd.id = owi.source_id and owi.is_deleted = false inner join first_mile_delivery_detail fmdd on fmd.id = fmdd.main_id and fmdd.is_deleted = false where fmd.is_deleted = false and fmd.source_id = #{id} group by fmd.code,fmd.create_time,fmd.approve_status,owi.code order by fmd.create_time desc

SELECT ra.ID, rad.ID AS detailId, rad.sku_id AS skuId, rad.sku_no AS skuNo, rad.platform_fn_sku AS platformFnSku, rad.platform_sku, rad.platform_spu, rad.picking_qty FROM requisition_application_detail rad INNER JOIN requisition_application ra ON rad.main_id = ra.ID AND ra.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE rad.is_deleted = FALSE
AND rad.id IN
#{id}
order by ra.ID,rad.create_time desc

select wdpd.platform_sku as platformSku, wdpd.platform_sku_name as platformSkuName, wdpd.sku_id as skuId, wdpd.sku_no as skuNo, wdpd.platform_sku as msku, wdpd.platform_fn_sku as fnSku, wdpd.platform_spu as asin, wdpd.is_combination as isCombination, wdpd.id as sourceDetailId from wms_delivery_plan wdp inner join wms_delivery_plan_detail wdpd on wdp.id = wdpd.main_id and wdpd.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and wdp.is_deleted = false and wdp.id = #{id}

--要货申请冻结 select rad.sku_id, rad.sku_no, rad.from_virtual_warehouse_id as virtual_warehouse_id, rad.from_warehouse_id as warehouse_id, 'requisitionApplication' as source_type, ra.id as source_id, ra.code as source_code, rad.id as source_detail_id, ra.handle_time as bill_date, ra.handle_time as trade_time, rad.virtual_frozen_qty as qty from requisition_application ra inner join requisition_application_detail rad on ra.id = rad.main_id and rad.is_deleted = false and rad.from_virtual_warehouse_id != '' and ra.status in ('handleIng','handle') and rad.virtual_frozen_qty > 0 where ra.is_deleted = false --加工单出库(海外仓/不走货件的fba) union all SELECT md.sku_id, md.sku_no, rad.from_virtual_warehouse_id as virtual_warehouse_id, rad.from_warehouse_id as warehouse_id, 'machineInfo' as source_type, mi.id as source_id, mi.code as source_code, md.id as source_detail_id, mi.approve_time as bill_date, mi.approve_time as trade_time, md.qty as qty FROM requisition_application ra INNER JOIN requisition_application_detail rad ON ra.id = rad.main_id AND rad.is_deleted = false AND rad.from_virtual_warehouse_id != '' INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery fmd ON fmd.source_id = ra.id AND fmd.is_deleted = false AND fmd.approve_status = 'approve' INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery_detail fmdd ON fmdd.is_deleted = false and fmdd.source_detail_id = rad.id and fmd.id = fmdd.main_id inner join machine_ref_so mrs on fmd.id = mrs.so_id and fmdd.id = mrs.so_detail_id and mrs.is_deleted = false inner join machine_detail md on mrs.machine_detail_id = md.id and md.is_deleted = false and md.qty > 0 inner join machine_info mi on mi.id = md.main_id and mi.is_deleted = false and mi.approve_status = 'approve' WHERE ra.is_deleted = false --加工单出库(fba) union all SELECT md.sku_id, md.sku_no, rad.from_virtual_warehouse_id as virtual_warehouse_id, rad.from_warehouse_id as warehouse_id, 'machineInfo' as source_type, mi.id as source_id, mi.code as source_code, md.id as source_detail_id, mi.approve_time as bill_date, mi.approve_time as trade_time, md.qty as qty FROM requisition_application ra INNER JOIN requisition_application_detail rad ON ra.id = rad.main_id AND rad.is_deleted = false and ra.type = 'fba' AND rad.from_virtual_warehouse_id != '' INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery fmd ON fmd.source_id = ra.id AND fmd.is_deleted = false AND fmd.approve_status = 'approve' INNER join ( select fmdd.id,fmdd.main_id,fmdd.delivery_qty,fsd.sku_id,fsd.fn_sku from first_mile_delivery_detail fmdd inner join fba_shipment_detail fsd on fsd.is_deleted = false and fmdd.source_detail_id = fsd.id where fmdd.is_deleted = false ) fmdd on fmd.id = fmdd.main_id and rad.sku_id = fmdd.sku_id and rad.platform_fn_sku = fmdd.fn_sku inner join machine_ref_so mrs on fmd.id = mrs.so_id and fmdd.id = mrs.so_detail_id and mrs.is_deleted = false inner join machine_detail md on mrs.machine_detail_id = md.id and md.is_deleted = false and md.qty > 0 inner join machine_info mi on mi.id = md.main_id and mi.is_deleted = false and mi.approve_status = 'approve' WHERE ra.is_deleted = false --直接调拨单出库(海外仓) union all SELECT tid.sku_id, tid.sku_no, rad.from_virtual_warehouse_id as virtual_warehouse_id, rad.from_warehouse_id as warehouse_id, 'transferInfo' as source_type, ti.id as source_id, ti.code as source_code, tid.id as source_detail_id, ti.approve_time as bill_date, ti.approve_time as trade_time, tid.qty as qty FROM requisition_application ra INNER JOIN requisition_application_detail rad ON ra.id = rad.main_id AND rad.is_deleted = false AND rad.from_virtual_warehouse_id != '' INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery fmd ON fmd.source_id = ra.id AND fmd.is_deleted = false AND fmd.approve_status = 'approve' INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery_detail fmdd ON fmdd.is_deleted = false and fmdd.source_detail_id = rad.id and fmd.id = fmdd.main_id inner join transfer_info_detail tid on tid.source_detail_id = fmdd.id and tid.is_deleted = false and fmd.delivery_warehouse_id = tid.out_warehouse_id and tid.qty > 0 inner join transfer_info ti on ti.id = tid.main_id and ti.is_deleted = false and ti.approve_status = 'approve' WHERE ra.is_deleted = false --直接调拨单出库(fba) union all SELECT tid.sku_id, tid.sku_no, rad.from_virtual_warehouse_id as virtual_warehouse_id, rad.from_warehouse_id as warehouse_id, 'transferInfo' as source_type, ti.id as source_id, ti.code as source_code, tid.id as source_detail_id, ti.approve_time as bill_date, ti.approve_time as trade_time, tid.qty as qty FROM requisition_application ra INNER JOIN requisition_application_detail rad ON ra.id = rad.main_id AND rad.is_deleted = false and ra.type = 'fba' AND rad.from_virtual_warehouse_id != '' INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery fmd ON fmd.source_id = ra.id AND fmd.is_deleted = false AND fmd.approve_status = 'approve' INNER join ( select fmdd.id,fmdd.main_id,fmdd.delivery_qty,fsd.sku_id,fsd.fn_sku from first_mile_delivery_detail fmdd inner join fba_shipment_detail fsd on fsd.is_deleted = false and fmdd.source_detail_id = fsd.id where fmdd.is_deleted = false ) fmdd on fmd.id = fmdd.main_id and rad.sku_id = fmdd.sku_id and rad.platform_fn_sku = fmdd.fn_sku inner join transfer_info_detail tid on tid.source_detail_id = fmdd.id and tid.is_deleted = false and fmd.delivery_warehouse_id = tid.out_warehouse_id and tid.qty > 0 inner join transfer_info ti on ti.id = tid.main_id and ti.is_deleted = false and ti.approve_status = 'approve' WHERE ra.is_deleted = false
